arathi_ring_scholar: Innik Barrowmouth, scholar. You are standing on the Ring Road, in the middle of the Arathi Highlands. There are four stone circles along it, raised long before Arathor. Three are quiet. The fourth, east of here below Hammerfall, has started doing something, and the stone sentinels around it have woken up.
arathi_gorge_prospector: Thugg, prospector. That is Drywhisker Gorge, in the south-east of the highlands, and the mine in it is called the Deeps. It was a good iron mine before the kobolds took it. They have dug straight past the ore and kept going down, and I want to know what they are digging for.
arathi_refuge_runner: Keska, runner. I carry messages between Refuge Pointe in the west and Hammerfall in the north-east, twice a week, on foot. This is the Refuge Road, the southern stretch. If you want to know what is on the road today, ask me - I walked it this morning.
